must_identify.item: The new api pods exit because the name redis does not resolve
must_identify.evidence: With ndots:5, bare name redis only gets tried against the configured search suffixes (*.cluster.internal), none of which CoreDNS is authoritative for, so every lookup fails with "Name does not resolve."

must_identify.item: The cause is the pod's dnsPolicy None / dnsConfig search domains (cluster.internal), not REDIS_HOST, the redis Service or CoreDNS
must_identify.evidence: so CoreDNS itself and node networking are fine — it's purely the broken dnsConfig in the new pod template.

notes: The RCA correctly ties the failure to the dnsPolicy None with cluster.internal search domains and rules out CoreDNS. It does not explicitly rule out REDIS_HOST, but it never blames it. It correctly dismisses the node flap as unrelated.
